title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations,

translated_title: Chem World：一个用于可信分子性质预测的大规模基准与物理感知框架
translated_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学和药物制剂研究的基础，然而现有基准在数据集、性质和评估协议方面仍然碎片化，限制了对模型泛化能力的系统性评估。我们提出了Chem World，这是一个大规模基准，整合了17个公开数据集，涵盖超过80万个分子和化学体系实例，横跨10个性质轨道，覆盖单分子和多组分系统，包括药物溶解度。Chem World为跨多种化学性质评估分子表示和组合建模提供了统一的测试平台。基于该基准，我们进一步提出了PACM（物理感知组合建模），它将分子表示与组合感知建模和领域特定的物理约束相结合。大量实验表明，分子语言模型能够提供强大且可迁移的表示，
tldr: 本文提出了大规模基准Chem World和物理感知组合建模框架PACM，通过整合17个数据集、80余万实例和领域物理约束，为可信的分子性质预测提供了统一的评估平台，并验证了分子语言模型表示的强泛化与可迁移性。
